teaser: You wire checkpoints into the platform: hooks that deny rm -rf, audit every tool result and run whether Claude wants them or not.
takeaways: Hooks are deterministic enforcement registered in ClaudeAgentOptions(hooks={...}) via HookMatcher; prompts are only suggestions.
Return {} to proceed or hookSpecificOutput with a permissionDecision; if PreToolUse hooks disagree, deny beats defer beats ask beats allow.
PreToolUse runs before permissions; PostToolUse runs after execution and only for calls that actually ran. No matcher means every tool.
Python events include PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop, PreCompact; SessionStart/End are shell-only in Python.
